newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks hit another record close.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks hit another record close.

text.p: * Toronto's key stock index rallied to close at another record
high, propelled by signs that North American central banks
have no reason to raise short-term interest rates further.

Toronto's key stock index climbed to its 19th record close of the year on Thursday, boosted by a rally in New York and signs that North American central banks have room to hold off hiking interest rates for now.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's 300 Composite Index rose 39 points to finish at 6588.04, slightly below an intra-day high and new all-time record of 6615.35 points.
Wall Street also rallied, closing up 100 points to 7895.
Market players cheered tame U.S. non-farm payrolls data for June, which showed the economy is growing at a moderate pace, said MMS International analyst Katherine Beattie.
